# Negotiation & Strategy

<div class="cat-head"><img class="light-only" src="/images/icons/draft-light.svg" alt="" /><img class="dark-only" src="/images/icons/draft-dark.svg" alt="" /><span>6 of the <a href="/commands/">60 commands</a>. Type each as shown in Claude Code or Cowork; Codex users name the skill.</span></div>

## `/fundadmin:fund lpa-negotiate <file>` {#lpa-negotiate}

LPA negotiation strategy & redline suggestions

Turns LP-unfavorable LPA provisions into counter-proposal language, ranked P0 to P4 with push/trade/accept stances, a four-round roadmap and concession matrix. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund lpa-negotiate` or asks for LPA negotiation strategy.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund lpa-negotiate <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-lpa-negotiate <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-lpa-negotiate <file>` |

**Writes** `NEGOTIATION-STRATEGY-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-lpa-negotiate/SKILL.md)

Uses the host's approved file access and the packaged helpers where required.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund benchmark <file>` {#benchmark}

ILPA-position deviations; illustrative ranges labelled

Lists departures from ILPA published positions as discussion points and shows the illustrative reference ranges in this skill, labelled not market data, with each term's effect. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund benchmark`, asks how terms compare, or shares an LPA.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund benchmark <file>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-benchmark <file>` |
| Codex | `$fund-benchmark <file>` |

**Writes** `BENCHMARK-REPORT-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-benchmark/SKILL.md)

**Dependencies and fallbacks**

- **identified comparable terms dataset** — market percentiles or prevalence. If unavailable: label illustrative comparisons; empirical benchmarks unavailable.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund plain-english <file>` {#plain-english}

Plain English translation of fund documents

Translates a fund document clause by clause into plain English: practical impact, risk flags, a defined-terms glossary, and worked waterfall and clawback examples. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund plain-english`, asks what a clause means, or shares an LPA or PPM.

## `/fundadmin:fund playbook <files>` {#playbook}

Terms playbook from multiple fund documents

Tracks how a firm's LPA terms drift across fund vintages and builds a negotiation playbook of observed positions and asks. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund playbook`, asks how terms changed between Fund II and Fund III, or shares LPAs from several vintages.

## `/fundadmin:fund search-precedent <query>` {#search-precedent}

Search prior reviews for similar provisions & negotiation precedent
